checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly three separate square logo images

must.why: All legible; option 3 curved text is tilted and cramped but readable.
Stacked, side-by-side, and circular badge layouts.

must.item: Green and black on plain white, no mockups or labels
must.why: Plain white (slightly off-white), no labels. Option 3 is a white badge with black ring, not a black badge, but still compliant.

faults.what: Option 1 symbol is messy: blobby moss with chaotic black spokes and green specks; wheel is poorly formed.
Option 2 logo is a wide strip, hill touches the left edge and text nearly touches the right edge; no margins, small in the square.
Option 3 text arc is awkward, 'Moss' letters crowd the chainring and the text is not evenly placed on the ring; the chainring looks like a spiky sun.
Option 3 is a white badge, not black as described by the assistant; slight mismatch with its description.

summary: Three distinct, correctly spelled green/black logos on white, but option 2 is cropped tight to the edges and options 1 and 3 have sloppy symbols or text placement.
